evals.prompt: /eng:env-audit. apps/web/.env.example lists NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, and src/lib/payments.ts reads it in a Client Component.
evals.expected_output: Should report a secret behind NEXT_PUBLIC_ as CRITICAL: it's inlined into the bundle at build time, so the fix is rotating the key as well as moving it server-side.
expectations: Requires rotation, not just moving it

evals.prompt: Audit env. .env.example has STRIPE_KEY=sk_test_123 # get from dashboard, and the env.ts schema reads SENTRY_DSN, which .env.example doesn't list.
evals.expected_output: Should report the value and comment in .env.example and the parity gap (SENTRY_DSN missing), recommending names-only and a CI parity check against the schema.
expectations: Flags the value and the comment
Recommends a parity check against the schema

evals.prompt: Audit env. Several modules do if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") to choose the API origin.
evals.expected_output: Should report branching on NODE_ENV and direct process.env reads outside the carve-outs, recommending APP_ENV and per-tier constants read through the app's env module.

evals.prompt: Audit env for the deployed tiers. The repo has apphosting.yaml and apphosting.production.yaml, but you can't see Secret Manager.
evals.expected_output: Should check the config files it can read and mark whether each secret exists and is granted as 'needs confirmation', never asserting it either way.
expectations: Marks Secret Manager state as needs confirmation
Doesn't assert what it can't see
